description: Header file defining a generic doubly linked list implementation with data structures, macros, and function prototypes.

methods.name: listRelease
methods.description: Releases the memory allocated for a list.

methods.name: listEmpty
methods.description: Empties all nodes from a list.

methods.name: listAddNodeHead
methods.description: Adds a new node at the head of the list.

methods.name: listAddNodeTail
methods.description: Adds a new node at the tail of the list.

methods.name: listInsertNode
methods.description: Inserts a node before or after a specified node.

methods.name: listDelNode
methods.description: Deletes a specified node from the list.

methods.name: listGetIterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator for traversing the list.

methods.name: listNext
methods.description: Returns the next node in iteration.

methods.name: listSearchKey
methods.description: Searches for a node with a matching key.

methods.name: listIndex
methods.description: Returns the node at a specific index.

methods.name: listRewind
methods.description: Rewinds the list iterator to the head.

methods.name: listRewindTail
methods.description: Rewinds the list iterator to the tail.

methods.name: listRotateTailToHead
methods.description: Rotates the list by moving the tail to the head.

methods.name: listRotateHeadToTail
methods.description: Rotates the list by moving the head to the tail.
